verdict.rationale: Unleash documents Unleash Edge as a self-hostable caching layer and read replica that serves thousands of SDKs, built for resilience. Targeting data such as user IDs, emails and IPs is evaluated inside the Edge node and never sent to Unleash Cloud or the upstream instance, so SDK traffic stays in-network. Backend tokens are documented for connecting Edge to Unleash. missing for 10: explicit documentation of Edge continuing to serve flags while the upstream is fully unreachable, independent or hands-on corroboration, and clarity on licensing tier (docs reference 'Enterprise Edge').
